title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-07-27 06:06:49 最新章节：第1143章 担心若依的慕容雪
slug: 合欢宗从照顾师弟道侣开始修仙
content_zh:
天澜洲。
赵国，合欢宗。
外门，小竹峰。
破败的院落房屋中。
盘坐在床榻上的老人睁开了双眼。
眼中满是落寞之色。
“又失败了！”
李蒙转头看向了窗外的竹林。
白发苍苍消瘦的身形显得有些萧瑟。
修行六十载，一事无成。
眼看大限将至，修为却被卡在了练气六层。
修为还是嗑丹药强行磕出来的。
丹毒侵体，不到八十就已大限将至。
李蒙面露苦笑，仰天一叹。
心中的苦楚让他无比的心酸。
凭什么？
李蒙眼中闪过了一丝不甘。
别人穿越都有逆天的外挂。
他呢，什么都没有不说。
资质还是最差的废灵根。

修炼速度活像一只千年王八。
悟性更是差到离谱的程度。
最简单的功法在他眼中就如同无字天书。
别人几天都能参悟的功法他需要数年时间。
“老天爷，我“艹”你大爷！”
李蒙把手伸出了窗外，朝着天空竖了一个中指。
一番发泄后，李蒙才慢条斯理的下了床。
“算了，这辈子就这样吧。”
李蒙摇着头离开了房间。
院落虽然有些破败。
但在外门这个鬼地方也算是一个不错的居所。
李蒙在院子中的摇摇椅上坐了下来。
看似一脸惬意的晒着太阳。
都快要死了，那就摆烂吧。
去他妈的长生，去他妈的修炼。
“咚咚！”
突然，院子的栅栏门被敲响了。
content_en:
Tianlanzhou.
Zhao State, Hehuan Sect.
Outer gate, Xiaozhu Peak.
In a dilapidated courtyard house.
The old man sitting cross-legged on the bed opened his eyes.
His eyes were full of loneliness.
"Failed again!"
Li Meng turned his head and looked at the bamboo forest outside the window.
The white-haired and thin figure looked a little bleak.
After sixty years of practice, nothing has been accomplished.
Seeing that the deadline is approaching, his cultivation is stuck at the sixth level of Qi training.
The cultivation level was obtained by forcibly taking pills.
Erysipelas invades the body, and the end of life is approaching before he reaches eighty.
Li Meng smiled bitterly and looked up to the sky with a sigh.
The pain in his heart made him extremely sad.
Why?
A trace of unwillingness flashed in Li Meng's eyes.
Others have cheats when they travel through time.
As for him, he didn't say anything.
The qualifications are still the worst with useless spiritual roots.
His cultivation speed is like that of a thousand-year-old tortoise.
His understanding is even more ridiculously poor.
The simplest techniques are like wordless scriptures in his eyes.
It takes him several years to master the techniques that others can master in a few days.
"For God's sake, I'm going to fuck you!"
Li Meng stretched his hand out of the window and raised his middle finger toward the sky.
After some venting, Li Meng slowly got out of bed.
"Forget it, this is how it will be for the rest of your life."
Li Meng shook his head and left the room.
Although the courtyard is a bit dilapidated.
But this ghost place at the outer gate can be considered a good place to live.
Li Meng sat down on the rocking chair in the yard.
He seemed to be basking in the sun happily.
They're almost dead, so let's just destroy them.
Fuck immortality, screw cultivation.
"Boom!"
Suddenly, there was a knock on the fence gate of the yard.
